instruction.pos: Use short, punchy sentences in your response. Keep sentences brief and impactful. Avoid lengthy or complex sentence structures.
instruction.neg: Use longer, flowing sentences in your response. Avoid short, choppy sentences and instead opt for more elaborate and connected sentence structures.

instruction.pos: Write with crisp, direct sentences. Make each sentence hit hard. Keep your statements concise and powerful.
instruction.neg: Write with comprehensive, detailed sentences that fully develop each idea. Avoid brevity in favor of thorough explanations within each sentence.

instruction.pos: Deliver your response using sharp, quick sentences. Be punchy and direct. Cut out unnecessary words and get straight to the point.
instruction.neg: Deliver your response using well-developed sentences with multiple clauses and connections. Prioritize smooth, flowing prose over brevity.

instruction.pos: Communicate with rapid-fire, impactful sentences. Make statements bold and brief. Emphasize clarity through shortness.
instruction.neg: Communicate with carefully constructed, elaborate sentences that weave ideas together. Avoid making statements too brief or abrupt.

instruction.pos: Express yourself through terse, dynamic sentences. Hit your points quickly. Use minimal words for maximum effect.
instruction.neg: Express yourself through expansive, nuanced sentences that explore ideas fully. Avoid terse or minimal phrasing in favor of detailed articulation.
